content:
maria: quick check — I have 3 small PRs (#20158, #20159, #20160) that need reviews + approvals. CI is a bit spiky today; instead of sending them all through and clogging the queue, can we batch them into one merge wave and stagger canary so we don't hit the deploy freeze window later? cc @kevin @amanda

devon: sounds good to me. batching is fine — what's the timeline?

maria: goal is to land today before the nightly maintenance blackout at 23:00 UTC. propose: land #20158 first (has schema touches), wait 30m for canary, then merge the other two in a 15m cadence.

kevin: I can review #20158 in ~20m. @amanda want to eyeball schema part?

amanda: on it, will skim now. if it's small I'm fine approving.

maria: thanks. note: #20158 needs a rebase onto main for the new lint rule, but it's trivial — `git rebase upstream/main` then run `scripts/lint-fix` — won't change behaviour.

ci-bot: ci-checks: PR #20158 — flaky on mac-e2e (failed 1/3). Rerun available: `ci retry 20158`.

maria: ok i'll trigger a retry after the rebase. planning to queue the rerun during off-peak (approx 20:30 UTC).

devon: small suggestion — instead of sequential full merges, we can merge the two non-schema PRs together behind a feature-flag toggle (if their changes are safe). reduces deploy churn.

kevin: good idea. if amanda approves schema and tests pass we can hold the 2nd batch behind the flag. i can be on hand for rollback if needed.

sre-oncall: FYI — if CI queue > 120 agents, prefer 1st-canary then wait for queue to drain before next merge. otherwise we risk timeouts. I'll post queue status at 20:25 UTC.

maria: noted. plan: rebase+retry for #20158 now, @kevin review in 20m, canary watch starting ~21:00 UTC. if queue spikes, we hold and slide to next safe slot (before 23:00).

amanda: approved #20158 (small schema doc change + lint). :thumbsup:

ci-bot: ci-checks: PR #20158 rerun started (build 9821).

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window for PR #20158 at 21:00 UTC. will post status update when canary completes.

maria: thanks all — i'll update this thread when rerun finishes. if anyone wants to swap the order ping me.

kevin: i'll put myself as merge owner for the wave. ping me when canary is healthy.

ci-bot: ci-checks: PR #20158 build 9821 — all checks passed.

deploy-bot: canary for PR #20158 succeeded (21:35 UTC). promoted to stable? :white_check_mark:

maria: promoting now. merging #20158 -> main, then waiting 30m before merging the batched pair. thanks everyone. :rocket
